spec_family.name: Human-readable spec family name
spec_family.description: What this spec covers and does not cover

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier applied to this spec

paintable_items.name: Paintable item name
paintable_items.counting_rules: Explain how quantities are counted and sourced from PaintScope

_adjacency_declarations_guidance.purpose: Declares surface relationships for finish continuity optimization at project level
_adjacency_declarations_guidance.primary_surface: The main substrate this spec addresses (from Surface_Vocabulary_Reference.md)
_adjacency_declarations_guidance.edge_type_linear: Two surfaces meet along a line (wall/baseboard, wall/casing)
_adjacency_declarations_guidance.edge_type_complex: Multiple surfaces form interconnected system (door assembly, window assembly)
_adjacency_declarations_guidance.typical_relationship: Expected finish relationship: same_finish, different_finish, or varies
_adjacency_declarations_guidance.continuity_rate_modifier: Rate improvement factor (1.0-2.0) when finishes are continuous
_adjacency_declarations_guidance.affected_tasks: Task IDs in sop_modules.json affected by this adjacency

_state_declarations_guidance.purpose: Declares substrate state requirements for engine validation and dynamic protection calculation
_state_declarations_guidance.valid_input_states: SS_* states this spec can operate on (e.g., SS_BARE for prime, SS_PRIMED for finish)
_state_declarations_guidance.output_state: SS_* state this spec produces (may vary by config dimension like sheen)
_state_declarations_guidance.adjacent_state_protection_rules: Protection needed based on adjacent surface states at execution time
_state_declarations_guidance.protection_level_enum: none = no masking, light_mask = tape only, full_mask = tape+paper, full_cover = full drape

valid_input_states.notes: Trim must be primed before finish application

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen configuration

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Protect finished walls from trim spray overspray
